blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.
blocks.zh: AI协助制作的教材激增,超过了我们验证其教学质量的能力。 使用Bloom分类模型的自动化评价是评估大规模教育材料的一种很有希望的办法。 这些模型显示出高度精确的分布内数据集(IID Dataset). 然而,将同样的模型应用于新的分配外(OO)数据集,例如AI协助生成的问题,可能显示性能退化。 为了在数据集转换下确定强力分类器,我们评价了传统的机器学习(ML),变压器,以及大语言模型在Bloom级别分类任务上. 我们还探索了将NLP衡量标准纳入的特征工程战略,将学习目标作为投入的一部分,并为稳定OD性能进行文字拼接。 我们的基线测试表明,TFPOS-IDF ML模型在OD(Macro F1-score 0.48)上的性能差于BERT(0.55)和LLM(0.79). 文本拓扑改进了ML和BERT模型的宏F1-分数性能(分别为0.59和0.62). 将学习目标与投入相配合,提高特定数据集的模型性能。 模式再培训在模型和数据集方面提供了最大的改进。 总的来说,这些调查结果突出了在使用经过预先培训的模型与新颖的AI辅助教育以及战略特征增强如何帮助解决绩效损失方面的权衡。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The surge in AI-assisted educational questions(AEQ) has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality ( Xing et al., 2024 ; Scaria et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . While LLMs are able to produce learning content at scale, ensuring their alignment with educational frameworks such as the Revised Bloom Taxonomy and Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) is a concern. Traditional expert-validation of questions is costly, time-consuming, and prone to human biases ( AlKhuzaey et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: AI援助教育问题(AEQ)的激增超过了我们验证其教学质量的能力(Xing等人,2024年;Scaria等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年)。 虽然法学硕士能够制作规模化的学习内容,但确保这些内容与教育框架(如订正的Bloom分类学和欧洲共同参考框架)保持一致,是一个令人关切的问题。 传统的专家鉴定问题代价高昂,耗时,容易引起人类偏见(Al Khuzaey等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Quality validation covers the alignment of materials with the Revised Bloom’s Taxonomy for cognitive depth and CEFR for language proficiency. Educational materials should capture both learning objectives and student’s level of knowledge against a defined difficulty. Moreover, the materials should allow progression from low-order thinking tasks (e.g., remember, understand, and apply) to higher-order cognitive tasks (e.g., analyze, evaluate, and create).
blocks.zh: 质量验证包括材料与订正Bloom的分类法一致,用于认知深度,而CEFR用于语言熟练程度. 教育材料应既反映学习目标,又反映学生在应对既定困难方面的知识水平。 此外,材料应当允许从低序思维任务(如记忆,理解,应用)向高序认知任务(如分析,评价和创建)发展.

blocks.en: Studies in Natural Language Processing (NLP) developed models capable of detecting Bloom signals (i.e., Bloom trigger Verbs) ( Mohammed and Omar, 2020 ; Waheed et al., 2021 ) and readability levels of text at scale ( Arase et al., 2022 ) . These models show high accuracy on IID. Whether these models deliver the same accuracy with novel AEQ remains unknown.
blocks.zh: 自然语言处理(NLP)研究开发了能够检测Bloom信号(即Bloom触发Verbs)的模型(Mohammed and Omar, 2020;Waheed等人, 2021年),以及可读性等级的文本(Arase等人, 2022年). 这些模型在ID中显示的精度很高. 这些模型是否与新颖的AEQ提供相同的精度,目前仍然未知.

blocks.en: AI-generated questions are verbose and may lack explicit linguistic signals (e.g., Bloom Verbs) found in human-curated training datasets used in previous models ( Mohammed and Omar, 2020 ; Yahya et al., 2012 ; Lau, 2025 ) . Feature-based models heavily rely on detecting these Bloom trigger verbs for classification. We hypothesize that text verbosity in AI-generated questions dilutes the Bloom signals resulting to under-performance of the models.
blocks.zh: AI生成的问题具有动词性,可能缺乏在以往模型(Mohammed and Omar,2020;Yahya等人,2012;Lau,2025)中使用的人语精准训练数据集中发现的明确语言信号(如Bloom Verbs). 基于特性的模型严重依赖检测这些Bloom触发动词进行分类. 我们假设人工智能生成的问题中的文字动词 淡化了Bloom的信号 导致模型表现不佳

blocks.en: To test this hypothesis, we examined the performance of different pre-trained models (SVM, XGBoost, BERT transformers, and Large Language Models) with AEQ and across different feature engineering strategies. In particular, we tested whether reducing long AEQ to short assertion clauses via text splicing supports model performance. Insights in this study can be used to fine-tune existing pedagogical-alignment classifiers to AEQ materials (or vice-versa) towards building quality personalized educational materials at scale.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这个假说,我们用AEQ和跨越不同特征工程策略检查了不同预训型号(SVM,XGBoost,BERT变压器,以及大语言型号)的性能. 特别是,我们测试了通过文本拼接将长的AEQ条款减少到短的断言条款是否支持模型性能. 本研究的洞察力可用于将现有的教学-校正分类器调整为AEQ材料(或反之亦然),以大规模建设优质的个性化教材.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: NLP models are developed support the evaluation of educational materials. This suite of models includes feature-based ML models, transformers and advanced LLMs. While each generation of models has improved in-domain classification for cognitive depth (Bloom’s Taxonomy) and language proficiency (CEFR), their susceptibility to out-of-distribution (OOD) performance degradation remains a central challenge.
blocks.zh: 开发了NLP模型,支持对教材的评价。 这一套模型包括基于特性的ML模型,变压器和高级LLMs. 虽然每一代模型都改进了认知深度(Bloom's Taxonomy)和语言熟练程度(CEFR)的域内分类,但是它们易受分配外(OOD)性能退化的影响仍然是一个中心挑战.

blocks.en: 2.1 Feature-based ML models
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于特征的ML模型

blocks.en: Early automated assessment models relied on expert-crafted linguistic features ( Benedetto et al., 2020 ) such as text statistics (word counts), Flesch-Kincaid readability index ( Flesch, 1948 ) , syntactic complexity (Part-of-Speech tags, parse tree depth) ( Mohammed and Omar, 2020 ) , and lexical diversity metrics. These features serve as inputs to ML model classifiers such as Multi-nomial Logistic Regression, Tree-based models, and Support-Vector Machine to capture statistical relationships of these features to a label (e.g., Bloom level or CEFR).
blocks.zh: 早期的自动化评估模型依赖于专家制作的语言特征(Benedetto等人,2020年),如文本统计(字数),Flesch-Kincaid可读性指数(Flesch,1948年),综合复杂性(部分语言标记,剖析树深)(Mohammed and Omar,2020年),以及词典多样性度量. 这些特性作为ML模型分类器的输入,如多诺米逻辑回归,基于树的模型,以及支持-维克特机器,以捕获这些特性与标签的统计关系(如Bloom关卡或CEFR).

blocks.en: Mohammed and Omar (2020) demonstrated the use of new engineered features such as a term weighting method (TFPOS-IDF) and Word2Vec (W2V) embeddings with ML models to classify the Bloom level of open-domain questions. By weighting Part-of-Speech (POS) such as verbs, nouns, and adjectives with weights calculated from Term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), Mohammed and Omar (2020) found high performance of ML models to classify with micro F1-scores up-to 0.87 (TFPOS-IDF). Furthermore, combining W2V embeddings with TFPOS-IDF features further increased performance to 0.90. Maharramov (2025) also found that Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with FastText embeddings out-performed 26 model-feature combination with macro F1-score of 0.831 ± 0.026 0.831\pm 0.026 . This underscores the role of feature-engineering in improving the performance of assessment models.
blocks.zh: Mohammed和Omar(2020年)演示了使用新的工程特征,如术语加权法(TFPOS-IDF)和Word2Vec(W2V)嵌入ML模型,以分类开放域问题的Bloom级别. 通过对动词,名词等部分语言(POS)进行加权,以及从Term频率反向文档频率(TF-IDF)计算出的带有权重的形容词,Mohammed和Omar(2020年)发现ML模型的性能很高,可以与微分F1-分数进行分类,最高可达0.87(TFPOS-IDF). 此外,将W2V嵌入式与TFPOS-IDF的特性相结合,性能进一步提高到0.90. 马哈拉莫夫(2025年)还发现,带有FastText嵌入的Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN)超越了26个模型-地貌组合,宏F1-分数为0.831±0.0260.831\pm 0.026. 这突出了特色工程在改进评估模型绩效方面的作用。

blocks.en: 2.2 Transformer models
blocks.zh: 2.2 变压器模型

blocks.en: Transformers learn sequence-to-sequence relation of words making them powerful models for text classification tasks ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Transformer models are found to be robust classifiers for evaluating Bloom level tasks. Waheed et al. (2021) reported their proposed transformer model (BloomNet) which out-performed TF-IDF Random Forest model (macro-F1 scores of 0.87 versus 0.71) for IID dataset and (0.67 versus 0.58) for OOD dataset. The performance drop in BloomNet model from IID to OOD dataset (macro-F1 scores of 0.87 to 0.67) highlights that transformers remain vulnerable to dataset shift.
blocks.zh: 变形器学习词的顺序与顺序的关系,使它们成为文本分类任务的强大模型(Vaswani等人,2017年). 变形器模型被发现是用于评价Bloom级任务的强力分类器. Waheed等人(2021年)报告了他们提议的变压器模型(BloomNet),该模型超越了TF-IDF随机森林模型(IID数据集的宏观-F1分数为0.87比0.71,OD数据集的分数为0.67比0.58)。 BloomNet模型的性能从ID降为OOD数据集(宏-F1分数0.87分到0.67分)突出表明变压器仍然容易受到数据集转移的影响.

blocks.en: 2.3 Large-Language Models (LLMs)
blocks.zh: 2.3 大语言模型

blocks.en: Pre-trained LLMs such as GPT-4 and Gemini can potentially replace model training with zero/Few-shot prompting. LLMs (e.g, GPT-4, Gemini). Huber and Niklaus (2025) evaluated different LLMs performance on Bloom level classification task. They found that LLama and GPT-4 show high agreement with human annotators for low-order Bloom levels (remember, understand, and apply) but noted a drop in performance with higher order skills (analyze, evaluate, create). Kumar et al. (2025) also found that LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4o-mini and Google Gemini-1.5-pro) had an acceptable performance, macro F1-score ∼ 0.72 \sim 0.72 . Thus, LLMs offer an out-of-the box assessment model.
blocks.zh: 诸如GPT-4和双子座等经过前训练的LLMS可以以0/Few-shot的提示取代模型训练. LLM(如GPT-4,双子座). Huber和Niklaus(2025年)在Bloom级别分类任务上评价了不同的LLMS性能. 他们发现LLama和GPT-4在低序Bloom水平(记住,理解,应用)上表现出与人类注释员的高度一致,但注意到有更高订单技能(分析,评价,创建)的性能下降. Kumar等人(2025年)也发现LLMs(OpenAI GPT-4o-mini和Google双子座1.5-pro)具有可以接受的性能,宏F1-分数 0.72\sim 0.72. 因此,LLMs提供了一个箱外评估模式。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We investigate the performance of ML, transformers and LLMs to assess the Bloom Taxonomy level particularly on new AEQ. We prepared two classes of datasets: Identically Independent Distributed (IID) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) datasets following the notation of Waheed et al. (2021) . The IID dataset is comprised of the collection of questions from text and websites compiled by Lau (2025) . The OOD datasets were produced using AEQ Generation from works of Scaria et al. (2024) and this study (Asyncform, referred to as "AF" here on). Baseline models were trained using the IID datasets only. The models transfer learning performance were evaluated using the OOD datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们调查ML,变压器和LLMs的性能,以评估Bloom分类学的水平,特别是在新的AEQ上. 我们编制了两类数据集:在Waheed等人(2021年)的注解之后,同样的独立分布(IID)和发布(OOD)数据集。 IID数据集包括从Lau(2025)汇编的文本和网站上收集问题。 OOD数据集是从Scaria等人(2024年)和本研究(Asyncform,此处称为"AF")的作品中利用AEQ世代制成的. 仅使用ID数据集对基线模型进行了培训。 使用OO数据集对模型转移学习绩效进行了评估。

blocks.en: We explored several configuration of inputs features for the model such as the TFIDF vectors, TFIDF with NLP metrics and CEFR level, and DistilBERT embeddings. We analyzed the extent of the misclassification using accuracy metrics, word cloud, and local explanable features. We then investigated approaches to improve model performance by feature engineering, text splicing, and retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们探讨了该模型的若干投入特征的配置,如技术开发基金矢量、具有NLP度量和CEFR水平的技术开发基金以及DistilBERT嵌入。 我们用精确度测量、字云和可以解释的地方特征,分析了错误分类的程度。 然后,我们通过专题工程、文字分解和再培训来研究改进模型性能的方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Asyncform (AF)
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成(AF)

blocks.en: In this study, we generated 863 AEQ covering subjects in English, Mathematics, and Science. AF dataset was labeled with corresponding Bloom Taxonomy level by three K-12 teachers who taught the subjects. Content information (i.e., subject, grade level, learning objectives, and question) was presented to the teachers in the annotation process. Due to limited staff, only a single Bloom label was provided for a given AEQ.
blocks.zh: 在这个研究中,我们产生了863个AEQ,涵盖英语,数学,和科学等学科. AF数据集被三位教授这些科目的K-12教师标注为相应的Bloom分类学级别. 内容信息(即科目、年级、学习目标和问题)在注释过程中提交给了教师。 由于员工有限,只为给定的AEQ提供了单一的Bloom标签.

blocks.en: 3.2 Feature Engineering
blocks.zh: 3.2 地物工程

blocks.en: To mitigate OOD performance degradation, we tested four feature-engineering configurations (Configurations A-D) that capture syntactic, semantic, and Bloom signals.
blocks.zh: 为了缓解OD性能退化,我们测试了四个功能-工程配置(Configulations A-D),这些配置能捕捉到综合,语义,和Bloom信号.

blocks.en: Configuration A (TFPOS-IDF vector) adapts the approach of ( Mohammed and Omar, 2020 ) which uses a TFPOS-IDF feature to represent text using its term frequency with part-of-speech (POS) weighting that highlights the impact of verbs, nouns, and adjectives in Bloom level classification task. As a pre-processing step, words were stemmed and weighted based on their POS-tags, i.e., 5 for verbs, 3 for nouns or adjectives, and 1 for others. The processed text was then converted to a sparse-vector representation using TF-IDF vectorizer trained on IID vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 配置 A(TFPOS-IDF 矢量) 适应了(Mohammed and Omar, 2020)的方法,它使用TFPOS-IDF的特性,用它的术语频率来代表文本,并配以部分语调(POS)的权重,在Bloom级别分类任务中突出动词,名词,形容词的影响. 作为前处理步骤,词根被根據其POS-tag,即动词5个,名词或形容词3个,其他1个. 处理过的文本随后被转换成使用经过ID词汇培训的TF-IDF矢量器的稀疏载体表示.

blocks.en: Configuration B (TFPOS-IDF + NLP Metrics + CEFR level) extends the TFPOS-IDF to include text metrics and CEFR level. We hypothesize that these metrics could improve classification performance.
blocks.zh: 配置B(TFPOS-IDF + NLP Metrics + CEFR级别)将TFPOS-IDF扩展至包括文本度量衡和CEFR级别. 我们假设这些衡量标准可以提高分类性能。

blocks.en: Configuration C (Text + LO) concatenates the learning objectives (LO), when available, to the question. This is applicable to the AF dataset. The joined text (question + LO) is then processed following TFPOS-IDF approach in Configuration A.
blocks.zh: 配置 C( Text + LO) 将学习目标( LO) , 可用时, 以表示问题 。 这适用于AF数据集. 然后按照配置A中的TFPOS-IDF方法处理合并文本(问题+LO).

blocks.en: Configuration D utilizes adapts the approach of ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) which utilized pre-trained DistilBERT embeddings as input features. Rather than using the [ 𝐶𝐿𝑆 ] \mathit{[CLS]} token, we used the pooled attention weights (768 x 1 vector) to train the downstream Fully-Connected-Network (FCN) classifier.
blocks.zh: 配置 D采用库马尔等人(Kumar等人,2025年)的方法,将训练前的DistilBERT嵌入作为输入特性。 我们没有使用[CLS]\mathit{[CLS]]符号,而是使用集合注意力权重(768 x 1 向量)来训练下游的Fully-connected-Network(FCN)分类器.

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en: We used ML, transformer, and LLMs for the Bloom classification task. The ML models include: Multi-nomial Logistic Regression, Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Fully Connected Network (FCN). We implemented standard model architecture: RF (100 estimators), SVM (linear kernel), XGB (100 estimators), and FCN (128x128 hidden layers). We set up a DistilBERT uncased transformer model ( Sanh et al., 2019 ) with an FCN (128x128 hidden layers, 0.30 drop-out and RELU activation function). For LLM evaluation, we used OpenAI GPT-4.1 and Google Gemini Flash 3.1 to estimate the Bloom level using zero-shot and few-shot prompting (see Annex).
blocks.zh: 我们用ML,变压器和LLMS 来完成Bloom分类任务. ML模式包括:多诺米物流回归,随机森林(RF),支持矢量机(SVM),以及Fully Connected Network(FCN). 我们实施了标准模型架构:RF(100个估计器),SVM(线性内核),XGB(100个估计器)和FCN(128x128隐藏层). 我们搭建了DistilBERT无案底变压器模型(Sanh等人,2019年),其FCN(128x128隐藏层,0.30退出和RELU激活功能). 对于LLM评价,我们使用OpenAI GPT-4.1和Google双子座闪光3.1来通过零镜头和几镜头的提示来估计Bloom的水平(见附件).

blocks.en: 3.4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluated all models using 5-fold cross-validation ( K = 5 K=5 ) along with the full-dataset, reporting the mean and standard deviation across folds. To handle target class imbalance, we incorporated class weighting into the loss-functions of the models while maintaining default hyperameters and freezing pre-trained BERT weights. Light ML models were trained on a Mac M1 computer running with Python 3.11 while the BERT model was trained using Google Colab (A100 GPU) with Adam optimizer ( 𝑙𝑒𝑎𝑟𝑛𝑖𝑛𝑔 ​ _ ​ 𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑒 = 1 × 10 − 3 \mathit{learning\_rate}=1\times 10^{-3} ) for 50 epochs and fixed random seed of 42.
blocks.zh: 我们利用5倍的交叉验证(K=5K=5)以及完整的数据集来评价所有模型,报告不同折叠的平均值和标准差。 为了处理目标类失衡,我们把类加权纳入模型的失能功能中,同时保持默认的超模和冻结预先训练的BERT重量. 轻ML模型在使用Python 3.11运行的Mac M1计算机上接受了训练,而BERT模型则使用Google Colab(A100 GPU)与Adam 优化器(学习_速率=1×10 − 3\mathit{学习X\_rate}=1\times 10^{-3})进行训练,为50个纪元和42个固定随机种子.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Textual characteristics of IID and OOD
blocks.zh: 4.1 ID和OO的文字特征

blocks.en: We measured the textual characteristics of the dataset such as: text statistics, readability metrics, syntactic depth, and CEFR level estimate.
blocks.zh: 我们测量了数据集的文字特征,例如:文本统计、可读性计量、综合深度和CEFR水平估计。

blocks.en: A set of metrics was used to describe the textual characteristics of the questions namely: text length (number of words), Flesch-Kincade Grade level, number of sentences, maximum syntactic depth, and number of root children. These metrics were calculated using Textstat ( Ward, 2022 ) and Spacy ( Honnibal et al., 2020 ) Python libraries.
blocks.zh: 一套衡量标准被用来描述问题的文字特征,即:文本长度(字数),弗莱施-金卡德等级,句数,最大合成深度,根子数量. 这些指标是使用Textstat(Ward,2022年)和Specy(Honnibal等人,2020年)Python图书馆计算的。

blocks.en: A BERT model pre-trained with CEFR-SP dataset ( Arase et al., 2022 ) was used to estimate the CEFR level of the IID and OOD dataset (see Annex). The predicted CEFR level was used as additional feature in exploring different feature configuration.
blocks.zh: 使用CEFR-SP数据集(Arase等人,2022年)预先培训的BERT模型估算了ID和OOD数据集的CEFR水平(见附件)。 预测的CEFR水平在探索不同的特征配置时被用作额外的特征.

blocks.en: 4.2 Feature Engineering and Text Splicing
blocks.zh: 4.2 特性工程和文字复制

blocks.en: We measure the classification performance via macro F1-score of different models on the IID and OOD datasets. We also examined potential improvement in the F1-score with feature engineering (see Section 3.2 ) and text splicing.
blocks.zh: 我们在ID和OOD数据集上通过宏F1分数测定不同模型的分类性能. 我们还研究了F1-分数方面可能的改进,包括特征工程(见第3.2节)和文本拼写。

blocks.en: We hypothesize that splicing text into sentences allows the ML models to locally detect the relevant Bloom triggers (Verbs, Nouns). In text splicing, a full text question, Q i Q_{i} , is split based on punctuations resulting to a set of single sentences, { q } i \{q\}_{i} . Q i = { q 1 , q 2 , … , q n } i Q_{i}=\{q_{1},q_{2},\ldots,q_{n}\}_{i}

blocks.en: 4.3 Misclassification and Improvements
blocks.zh: 4.3 错误分类和改进

blocks.en: We focused our analysis on the best performing ML models from Section 5.2 . We hypothesized that misclassification is due to the dilution and/or lack of the Bloom signal in the text. We characterize the signal dilution as the drop in F1-score with text length.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析集中于第5.2节中表现最好的ML模型。 我们假设错误的分类 是由于文本中 布鲁姆信号的稀释和/或缺乏。 我们把信号稀释定性为F1分数与文本长度的下降.

blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Textual Characteristics of IID and OOD.
blocks.zh: 5.1 ID和OO的文字特征。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the overall textual characteristics of the IID and OOD datasets. The IID dataset compiled by Lau (2025) has a large sample size N = 6,175 N=6,175 compared to the total OOD dataset of N = 2,696 N=2,696 entries.

blocks.en: IID entries are short (mean length ∼ \sim 10 words), single sentences, with shallow syntactic depth (only 34.9% of data have >5 max depth) and suitable for Grade 10 (FKG   9.6). Majority (88.8%) of the IID have CEFR levels of B1 and B2. In contrast, the OOD dataset exhibits longer text (mean length > 20 words), with more than one sentence (43% for Scaria, 17% for the AF), has deeper syntactic depth (94% of data have > 5 >5 max depth) and suitable for Grade levels 9 to College. The OOD estimated English proficiency level are higher covering B1-B2 (at least 63% of Scaria) and C1-C2 (at least 25% of AF).

blocks.en: Word cloud analysis shows that IID dataset contains rich sets of verbs in different Bloom levels (see Figure 1 ). However, the OOD dataset shows only partial overlap on the set of Bloom trigger verbs. The OOD-Scaria dataset shows the highest overlap of Bloom Verbs (median = 35.1%) while the AF dataset shows least overlap (median = 10.5%).

blocks.en: 5.2 Model performance with Feature Engineering and Text Splicing
blocks.zh: 5.2 与地物工程和文本复制有关的模型性能

blocks.en: There is a low transfer performance between the IID and OOD test datasets (see Table 2 ). A Naïve model - with the majority class as the prediction, has macro F1-scores of 0.09 (IID) and 0.06 (OOD-Scaria) and 0.07 (OOD-AF). With TFPOS-IDF as features, all models show high F1-score ( 0.88) with the IID datasets, particularly XGBoost. However, their performance decreased with the OOD dataset to 0.48 ± 0.02 0.48\pm 0.02 (Scaria, XGBoost) and 0.18 ± 0.02 0.18\pm 0.02 (AF, XGBoost).
blocks.zh: IID和OOD测试数据集之间的传输性能较低(见表2)。 一个Naïve模型——以多数类作为预测,其宏F1分数分别为0.09(IID)和0.06(OOD-Scaria)和0.07(OOD-AF)。 以TFPOS-IDF为特性,所有模型都以ID数据集,特别是XGBoost显示高F1-分数(0.88). 然而,随着OOD数据集的开发,他们的性能下降至0.48±0.02 0.48\pm 0.02(斯卡利亚,XGBoost)和0.18±0.02 0.18\pm 0.02(AF,XGBoost).

blocks.en: The addition of NLP and CEFR as features showed marginal improvement in the F1-score particularly for RF model from (0.20 to 0.25 in the OOD-AF).Complex models such as DistilBERT and LLMs show higher performance compared to previous ML models. DistilBERT model had F1-scores of 0.89 (IID) and 0.35 to 0.56 (for OOD). LLMs (GPT4.1 and Gemini-Flash 3.1 lite) showed robust classification performance with the OOD datasets, F1-scores from 0.41 to 0.79.
blocks.zh: 添加NLP和CEFR作为特征表明F1-分数略有改善,尤其是RF模型从(OD-AF中的0.20到0.25)。 与之前的ML模型相比,DistilBERT和LLMS等复杂的模型表现出更高的性能. DistilBERT模型的F1分数为0.89(IID)和0.35至0.56(OD). LLM(GPT4.1和双子座-Flash 3.1升)在OOD数据集,F1分数从0.41到0.79的分类性能显示强劲.

blocks.en: 5.3 Misclassifications
blocks.zh: 5.3 错误分类

blocks.en: The Figure 2 below shows the confusion matrix for XGBoost, BERT, and Gemini-3.1-Flash revealing model biases across datasets. For the IID dataset, XGBoost and BERT perform well across Bloom Levels. Gemini showed a high number of misclassifications particularly on low order Bloom levels ("remember" and "understand"). For the OOD dataset, both pre-trained XGBoost and BERT models show a bias in "understand" prediction in Scaria and AF dataset. BERT model correctly predicts higher-order Bloom level ("create") questions in the Scaria dataset. In contrast, Gemini-FS shows robust performance with relatively high accuracy across bloom levels.
blocks.zh: 下图2显示XGBoost、BERT和双子座3.1-Flash的混淆矩阵,显示各数据集的模型偏差。 对于ID数据集,XGBoost和BERT在Bloom Levels之间表现良好. 双子座表现出大量错误分类,特别是在低级的Bloom级别("记住"和"理解")上. 对于OOD数据集,预先训练的XGBooost和BERT模型在Scaria和AF数据集中都显示出"理解"预测的偏差. BERT模型在Scaria数据集中正确预测了更高顺序的Bloom级别("create")问题. 相比之下,双子座-FS表现出强劲的性能,在开花级中精度相对较高.

blocks.zh: 图 2: XGB,DistilBERT,和双子座-3.1-Flash的混淆矩阵,在ID和OOD数据集上少有镜头提示.

blocks.en: In terms signal dilution, model accuracy tends to drop with text length. However, the extent of dilution varies with IID and OOD datasets. For IID-Lau, the accuracy of BERT model drops to 80% with text length 20-30 words. For OOD-Scaria, performance of ML and BERT models drop to 50% with text length 15-20 words. LLMs still exhibit dilution however their accuracy remained high (>70%) even for longer text (text length > > 20 words). For OOD-AF, all models show low performance (accuracy < 50%) for text length 5 - 30 words with LLMs having the highest score.
blocks.zh: 在信号稀释方面,模型精度往往随文字长度而下降. 然而,稀释程度因ID和OOD数据集而异. 对于IID-Lau来说,BERT模型的精度下降至80%,文本长度为20-30字. 对于OOD-SCaria,ML和BERT模型的性能下降至50%,文本长度为15-20字. LLMS仍然表现出稀释,但即使文本较长(文本长度 > > 20字),其准确度仍然很高(>70%)。 对OOD-AF来说,所有模型的文本长度5 - 30个单词的性能都很低(准确度 < 50%),而LLMs的得分最高.

blocks.en: Figure 3: The drop in the accuracy of different models with the text length across the IID and OOD dataset indicating signal dilution.
blocks.zh: 图3 不同模型的精度下降,其文本长度横跨ID和OOD数据集,表示信号稀释.

blocks.en: 5.4 Improvements summary
blocks.zh: 5.4 改进摘要

blocks.en: The tables below summarizes the macro F1-scores of ML and BERT to the OOD datasets following the addition of features, learning objective, text splicing, and retraining. The baseline case show that DistilBERT having the best performance in Scaria 4 and AF dataset 5 . In general, improvements were observed following text splicing, addition of learning objectives and model retraining. With the Scaria dataset, XGBoost model performance increased with text splicing (0.59 versus 0.48 from baseline). With retraining, XGBoost model also out-perform BERT model (0.82 versus 0.77). With the AF dataset, BERT was better performing than XGBoost. BERT performance improved following retraining (0.50 versus 0.30) at par with the best performing LLMs for AF dataset (0.51, GPT4.1 - ZS). Model retraining addressed model biases on "understand" to "analyze" bloom levels (see Figure 4 ) particularly for Scaria dataset. However, prediction bias is still evident with the AF dataset. The inclusion of learning objectives in the text during retraining marginally improved BERT performance (0.54 versus 0.50).
blocks.zh: 下表总结了在增加特征、学习目标、文本分解和再培训之后,ML和BERT在OOD数据集中的宏F1分数。 基线案例显示,DistilBERT在Scaria 4和AF数据集5中表现最好。 总的来说,在文本分解、学习目标增加和模式再培训之后,出现了改进。 有了Scaria数据集,XGBoost模型性能随着文本的分解而增加(从基线的0.59比0.48). 通过再培训,XGBoost模式也超越了BERT模式(0.82对0.77). 有了AF数据集,BERT的表现优于XGBoost. 在再培训(0.50比0.30)之后,BERT的性能有所改善,与AF数据集(0.51,GPT4.1-ZS)最佳的LLMS相同。 模型再培训针对的是模型对“理解”到“分析”开花水平的偏差(见图4),特别是对Scaria数据集而言。 然而,AF数据集的预测偏差仍然很明显. 在再培训期间将学习目标纳入文本中,BERT的表现略有改善(0.54比0.50)。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, we evaluated the performance of pre-trained ML-based Classification models applied to novel AI-assisted educational questions OOD datasets. Consistent with the findings of ( Waheed et al., 2021 ) , the BERT classification models perform well on the datasets they were trained (IID). However, these models struggle to classify novel AI-assisted questions. We suggest two possible explanations: (1) AI-assisted education questions are verbose, which dilutes the Bloom signals; and (2) generated questions lack explicit use of Bloom trigger verbs that are important for classification.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们评价了应用在新型AI辅助教育问题OOD数据集的基于ML的预训分类模型的性能. 与(Waheed等人,2021年)的调查结果一致,BERT分类模型在所培训的数据集(IID)上表现良好. 然而,这些模型却挣扎着将新颖的AI辅助问题分类. 我们建议两种可能的解释:(1)AI辅助的教育问题是动词,淡化了Bloom的信号;(2)产生的问题没有明确使用Bloom触发动词,这对于分类很重要.

blocks.en: Because AI-assisted questions tend to incorporate context or situational examples, the increased text length dilutes Bloom signal and decreases the performance of TFPOS-IDF classifiers. As shown in Section 5.3 , model accuracy drops with text length with Bloom Signal dilution specific to different datasets. To enhance the signal-to-noise ratio, text splicing was effective in isolating sentences that contain clear Bloom levels evident in the Scaria Dataset.
blocks.zh: 由于AI辅助问题往往包含上下文或情境实例,增加的文本长度淡化了Bloom信号,降低了TFPOS-IDF分类器的性能. 如第5.3节所示,模型精度随着文本长度的下降而随着Bloom Signal dilitization的特异于不同的数据集. 为了提高信号对噪比,文本分解在Scaria Dataset显示的包含清晰的Bloom水平的句子中是有效的.

blocks.en: AI-assisted Educational questions tend to lack clear bloom signal. Most of pre-trained Bloom classifiers are designed to detect presence of Bloom Trigger Verbs. With the AF dataset, we found that adding the learning objective to the questions substantially improved classification performance. This finding aligns with ( Li et al., 2022 ) , demonstrating that the learning objectives serve as anchor features for Bloom level classification task . We noted that splicing had a detrimental effect on the classification score. This indicates that the combination of questions and learning objective provide clear Bloom signals.
blocks.zh: AI协助的教育问题往往缺乏明显的开花信号. 大多数预先训练的Bloom分类器都是为了探测Bloom Trigger Verbs的存在而设计的. 有了AF数据集,我们发现在问题中增加了学习目标,大大提高了分类业绩。 这一结论与(Li等人,2022年)一致,表明学习目标成为Bloom一级分类任务的支柱。 我们注意到,分型对分类分数有不利影响。 这表明问题和学习目标的结合提供了明确的布鲁姆信号.

blocks.en: Model retraining substantially improved model performance. Notably, the performance of the XGBoost model was comparable to BERT models. This indicates that the existing TFPOS-IDF features are sufficient. However, this task requires a large dataset, particularly for complex models.
blocks.zh: 模式再培训大大提高了模式性能。 值得注意的是,XGBoost模型的性能与BERT模型相当. 这表明现有的TFPOS-IDF特性已经足够了. 然而,这项任务需要大型数据集,特别是复杂的模型。

blocks.en: The marginal improvements on the re-trained models on the AF-dataset in Table 5 indicate a novel pattern that is not captured by the models. Using LIME interpretability tool, we found muted impact of nouns(NN), verbs(VB), and adjectives(JJ) in the AF Dataset to predicted Bloom Level (LIME weight< 0.50) (see Annex 3). To improve AF classification, we may need to (1) add more training data for the transformer to learn complex relations of NN, VB, and JJ; (2) consider restructuring the questions to include high-impact VB, NN.
blocks.zh: 表5中对AF-数据集上的重新训练模型的微小改进,表明模型没有捕捉到一种新的模式. 使用LIME可解释工具,我们在AF数据集中发现了名词(NN),动词(VB)和形容词(JJ)的哑弹影响,以预测布鲁姆级(LIME重量 < 0.50)(见附件3). 为了改进AF分类,我们可能需要(1)为变压器增加更多的训练数据,以学习NN,VB和JJ的复杂关系;(2)考虑调整问题结构,以包括高影响VB,NN.

blocks.en: From these findings, we provide three recommendations to address loss of model performance in novel OOD datasets. First, if no access to annotated datasets, use BERT and LLMS which provide robust bloom classification performance. Second, if with access to sample OOD datasets with labels, explore feature engineering approaches (e.g., text splicing and addition of learning objectives) to transform OOD dataset to be similar to IID data. Third, if one has access to a large OOD labeled dataset (N > 1,000 samples), retrain the model.
blocks.zh: 从这些调查结果中,我们提出了三项建议,以解决新的OOD数据集模型性能损失问题。 第一,如果无法访问附加说明的数据集,则使用BERT和LLMS,它们提供强劲的开花分类性能。 第二,如果可以访问带有标签的OOD数据集样本,则探索特征工程方法(如文本分解和添加学习目标),将OOD数据集转换为类似于ID数据. 第三,如果人们可以访问一个大的OD标签数据集(N > 1000样本),则重新训练模型。

blocks.en: 7 Summary and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 总结和今后的工作

blocks.en: In conclusion, we demonstrate that AI-generated questions - due to its verbosity introduce dataset shift degrading performance of pre-trained Bloom Taxonomy Classifiers. Our findings align with previous observations that models suffer a performance drop of approximately 20% when moving to out-of-distribution educational content. We show that techniques like text splicing and the integration of learning objectives provide additional information for "Bloom signals" in classification. While transformer-based models like BERT and LLMs consistently offer more robust baseline performance than traditional frequency-based methods, strategic model retraining remains the most effective path toward achieving high pedagogical alignment. By establishing a validated framework for the assessment of synthetic content, this study enables the scalable production of high-quality learning materials that strictly adhere to established standards such as the Revised Bloom Taxonomy. These results also highlight the need for collaboration between AI developers and educators, ensuring that the surge in automated content generation is met with equally rigorous automated validation.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们表明人工智能产生的问题——由于其动词性,引入了数据集转换,使预先训练的Bloom分类仪的性能下降。 我们的研究结果与先前的观察一致,即模型在转向分配外教育内容时的成绩下降约20%。 我们显示,诸如文本拼接和学习目标的整合等技术为分类中的"血光信号"提供了额外的信息. 虽然BERT和LLMS等基于变压器的模型比传统的频率方法一贯提供更强有力的基线性能,但战略模型再培训仍然是实现高教学一致性的最有效途径。 通过建立经验证的合成内容评估框架,本研究使得能够以可扩展的方式生产出严格遵循"订正布鲁姆分类学"等既定标准的高质量学习材料. 这些结果也突出了AI开发者与教育者之间需要合作,确保自动化内容生成的激增得到同样严格的自动化验证.

blocks.en: Annex 3. LIME Interpretability
blocks.zh: 附件3. LIME可解释性

blocks.en: With the retrained BERT model, we analyzed the model feature importance via LIME across the three datasets. Features were grouped by their POS tags and accuracy (see Figure 5 ). LIME evaluation show that model relies on presence of high-impact of nouns, verbs, and adjectives (NN, VB, and JJ) for correct prediction across datasets. Across the Lau and Scaria dataset, correct predictions relied on high impact tokens (NN, VB, and JJ with LIME weights > 0.50). In addition, the Scaria dataset included reliance on CW(Connecting and Structural words, e.g., “in”, “the”, “on”, “a”). In contrast, the AF dataset show muted impact of NN, VB, and JJ. Using Chi-square test confirmed high association between dataset domain and high-impact verbs ( χ 2 = 31.44 \chi^{2}=31.44 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and Nouns ( χ 2 = 8.54 \chi^{2}=8.54 , p < 0.014 p<0.014 ) but not on adjectives ( p = 0.085 p=0.085 ). To improve AF classification, we may need to (1) add more training data (consistent with paper) for the transformer to learn complex relations of NN, VB, and JJ; (2) consider restructuring the questions to include high-impact VB, NN.
blocks.zh: 随着BERT模型的再训练,我们通过LIME分析模型在三个数据集中的重要性。 特征按其POS标记和准确性分类(见图5)。 LIME评价显示,模型依赖于名词,动词和形容词(NN,VB,和JJ)的高影响存在,以正确预测跨数据集. 在整个Lau和Scaria数据集中,正确的预测依赖于高撞击指数(NN,VB,和具有LIME重量大于0.50的JJ). 此外,Scaria数据集包括依赖CW(连接和结构词,例如“in”、“the”、“on”、“a”)。 相比之下,AF数据集显示NN,VB和JJ的微弱影响. 使用Chi-square测试确认了数据集域与高影响动词之间的高度关联(χ2 = 31.44\chi^{2}}=31.44,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)和名词(χ2 = 8.54\chi^{2}}=8.54,p < 0.014 p < 0.014),但不在形容词上(p=0.085 p=0.085). 为了改进AF分类,我们可能需要(1)为变压器增加更多的培训数据(与纸张一致),以学习NN,VB,和JJ的复杂关系;(2)考虑调整问题的结构,以包括高影响VB,NN.

blocks.en: Figure 5: The box-plot distribution of the feature importance with the retrained BERT model using LIME. The model relies on high impact nouns, verbs, and adjectives (NN, VB, JJ) to form a correct prediction. The POS distribution also varies across datasets suggesting that each dataset have different text structure which impacts model performance.
blocks.zh: 图5:利用LIME进行再训练的BERT模型对特征重要性进行盒式布局分布. 模型依靠高撞击名词,动词,形容词(NN,VB,JJ)来形成正确的预测. POS的分布也因数据集而异,表明每个数据集都有不同的文本结构影响模型性能.
